blockers.title: Open scientific question: vanishing cycle-averaged time derivative versus vanishing stored-energy term in Lord-Shulman theory
blockers.detail: MATHEMATICAL QUESTION RESOLVED in Phase 1D; PHYSICAL QUESTION REMAINS OPEN, so this blocker is NOT closed. The derivation in theory/energy_flux_derivation.tex sec:ls-closure proves Proposition prop:relax: for a monochromatic field <q.qdot> = 0 IDENTICALLY while <q.q> = |Q|^2/2 is NOT zero, so the vanishing of the first is not evidence about the second. The EIT stored-energy density tau_q q.q/(2 kappa T0) is therefore genuinely non-zero. What remains open is which functional an EXPERIMENT measures, and that requires a complete scattering solution. The original text below is retained unchanged. ORIGINAL: The cycle average of q.dq/dt is IDENTICALLY ZERO for a monochromatic field, because it is the average of a product of a quantity with its own time derivative over a period. Phase 1 treated tau_q q.dq/dt/kappa as a 'relaxation storage' term and then as a dissipation; both readings are unsupported for a monochromatic field, since the term is zero. It is therefore NEITHER storage NOR dissipation in the harmonic regime. Whether Lord-Shulman theory carries a genuine out-of-phase stored-energy contribution, and if so what its correct harmonic expression is, is NOT settled by the observation that this particular term vanishes. Resolving it requires a complete thermodynamic derivation of the LS internal energy, not a numerical test.

blockers.title: Electrical interface model is BONDED, and the discarded Dz row is the INSULATED condition
blockers.detail: Recorded as a standing constraint rather than a defect. The system imposes a bonded (shorted) contact: displacements and tractions continuous, potential continuous, normal D free to jump by a surface charge. The Dz row at k=0 is Gauss's law D_z=0, which is the INSULATED (open-circuit) condition. The two are different physical models and must not be combined or interchanged. MR09 keeps the Dz row and is detected by EQ-02A-GAUGE-06 specifically because of this distinction. Any future change to the electrical interface model must be derived and validated separately.

cases.expected: no PHYSICAL_GROWING or other self-contradictory label; radiation_dir from sign(Im xi) when it is non-zero, and from sign(<J_z>) when the mode is lossless
cases.tol_justification: categorical equality; no numeric tolerance applies
cases.actual: 72 modes, 4 independent fields, no forbidden labels
cases.detail: radiation direction follows Im(xi), not the spatial class

cases.purpose: convention e^{+i xi z} reverified by direct field evaluation
cases.oracle: |f(z)| = |f(0)| e^{-Im(xi) z} evaluated at two z values
cases.fixture: PZT-5H and Al6061 at 30 deg, 1 MHz
cases.expected: measured decay rate equals -Im(xi) for every branch
cases.tol_justification: relative agreement limit at 60 digits of working precision; residual observed ~1e-50
cases.actual: 16 branches: measured decay rate == -Im(xi)
cases.detail: convention e^{+i xi z} confirmed by field evaluation

cases.purpose: modal classification is invariant across working precision
cases.oracle: repeated solve at seven independent working precisions
cases.fixture: PZT-5H and Al6061 at 30 deg, 1 MHz, dps 50..120
cases.expected: one and only one classification signature per material
cases.tol_justification: categorical invariance; any difference is a defect
cases.actual: identical classification at dps 50,60,80,90,100,110,120
cases.detail: the robust null-vector route removes the dependency

cases.purpose: gauge modes are separated from modes that carry energy
cases.oracle: machine-zero mechanical content with a distinct null vector
cases.fixture: Al6061 and PZT-5H at 30 deg, 1 MHz
cases.expected: GAUGE implies ZERO flux and exclusion from both half-spaces
cases.tol_justification: measured: true gauge mechanical content is exactly 0 relative to scale; smallest physical mode 4.01e-13
cases.actual: gauges carry ZERO flux and are excluded from half-spaces
cases.detail: gauge detection uses machine-zero mechanical content

cases.purpose: half-space admissibility requires boundedness AND non-triviality
cases.oracle: boundedness of e^{+i xi z} as |z| -> infinity
cases.fixture: PZT-5H, Al6061, CdSe at 30 deg, 1 MHz
cases.expected: gauges only in gauge_excluded; decaying modes in exactly one half-space; lossless modes admissible in BOTH halves, listed as non-decaying AND carrying a flux-derived direction
cases.tol_justification: categorical; Im(xi) is exactly zero or not
cases.actual: screening admits exactly the modes that decay into each half-space
cases.detail: 8 + 8 + 8 modes across three materials

cases.purpose: normal incidence reports which scale the attenuation used
cases.oracle: |Im xi| / sqrt(w rho cE / kappa33) recomputed independently
cases.fixture: PZT-5H, Al6061, CdSe at k=0 (normal incidence), 1 MHz
cases.expected: attenuation_basis names the thermal fallback and the reported ratio equals |Im xi|/|xi_th|
cases.tol_justification: relative identity check at 60 digits of precision
cases.actual: 24 normal-incidence branches report the thermal fallback
cases.detail: no blank attenuation field; basis is explicit and correct

cases.purpose: published inventory and manifest are immutable and consistent
cases.oracle: sha256 of each file as published
cases.expected: both digests match the pinned values
cases.tol_justification: exact digest comparison; no tolerance applies
cases.actual: inventory a3b2965319a49fb2 pinned
cases.detail: artifact and manifest are consistent and frozen

cases.purpose: every exported field matches an independent recomputation for that branch
cases.oracle: dispersion polynomial evaluation, independent root bank, recomputed flux for the row's own eigenvector
cases.expected: no row shows another branch's root or flux; all 120 agree
cases.tol_justification: relative agreement at 60 digits of working precision; print rounding is 1e-10
cases.actual: 120 rows verified against independent recomputation
cases.detail: root, flux, class, direction, admissibility, confidence and prose all agree with the source calculation

cases.purpose: no two rows in a material/angle block share the same root
cases.oracle: cardinality of the exported (Re_xi, Im_xi) set per block
cases.expected: distinct roots wherever the independent bank is distinct; a repeated root is allowed only where the bank genuinely has one; branch indices contiguous from 0
cases.tol_justification: set cardinality; duplicates are exact or absent
cases.actual: 15 blocks verified; 3 block(s) have a genuine repeated root at k=0 (double root at the origin), all others distinct; indices contiguous
cases.detail: no block shows the P0-1 symptom of distinct bank roots collapsing onto one exported value

cases.purpose: lossless modal flux points along the axial phase velocity
cases.oracle: sign(J_z) vs sign(Re xi) with c = sqrt(mu/rho) > 0
cases.fixture: Al6061 at 30 deg, branches with Im(xi)=0
cases.expected: J_z != 0 and sign(J_z) == sign(Re xi) for every lossless flux-carrying branch
cases.tol_justification: sign comparison; no numeric tolerance applies
cases.actual: 2 lossless modes: sign(J_z) == sign(Re xi), c = 0.576066 m/s > 0
cases.detail: flux direction agrees with the axial phase velocity

cases.purpose: the integrity validator detects every injected defect
cases.oracle: deliberately corrupted row sets compared against the independent recomputation
cases.expected: all 7 mutations detected
cases.tol_justification: boolean detection; no tolerance applies
cases.actual: 7/7 mutations detected: last-branch root repeated across rows(300), last-branch flux repeated across rows(168), branch-index shift(689), opposite radiation direction(114), missing outgoing propagating mode(2), gauge accepted as outgoing(42), inconsistent reasons vs numeric fields(14)
cases.detail: each injected defect produced at least one validation failure

cases.purpose: a tampered manifest checksum or count is detected
cases.oracle: sha256 of the CSV recomputed from disk
cases.expected: manifest output_sha256, rows and supersedes all correct, and a corrupted checksum is detectable
cases.tol_justification: exact digest comparison
cases.actual: checksum, row count and supersession all verified; a broken checksum is detectable
cases.detail: manifest is consistent with its artifact

cases.purpose: the invalid task-1 artifact is marked INVALID and preserved
cases.oracle: sha256 of each artifact against the registry entry
cases.expected: V1 INVALID and still on disk, V2 ACTIVE and matching its manifest, Phase 1D evidence unmodified
cases.tol_justification: exact digest comparison
cases.actual: 8 artifacts registered: 1 HISTORICAL, 1 INVALID (bytes preserved), 1 ACTIVE
cases.detail: invalid artifact is recorded and retained, not deleted

cases.purpose: the assembly's modal machinery reproduces the independently derived isotropic P-SV reference
cases.oracle: elastic_reference.solve_psv, itself validated against closed-form Fresnel, Snell, acoustic and grazing limits
cases.expected: all four complex amplitudes agree to < 1e-40
cases.tol_justification: both sides use 50-digit arithmetic, so agreement is at rounding; the measured worst case is 5e-42
cases.actual: worst difference 6.588e-52
cases.detail: the assembly builds its own columns and selection rule; nothing is imported from solve_psv

cases.purpose: unknowns equal the admitted-mode count and gauges are excluded
cases.oracle: the assembly's own modal inventory, recomputed from the roots
cases.fixture: Al6061, PZT-5H and Al6061|PZT-5H at 0/30/60 deg
cases.expected: n_unknowns == admitted side1 + admitted side2; no gauge admitted
cases.tol_justification: exact integer comparison
cases.actual: counts follow the inventory
cases.detail: a square 8x8 appears only where the physics supplies it

cases.purpose: a mechanically decoupled mode with D_z != 0 is ELECTROSTATIC and admissible, not a GAUGE
cases.oracle: D_z = -eps33*xi*phi evaluated from the medium constants and the root, independent of any component-norm comparison
cases.fixture: Al6061 at 30 deg (eps33 = eps0, no piezoelectric coupling)
cases.expected: D_z = -eps33*k = -6.954e-9, mode admitted
cases.tol_justification: D_z is computed two ways from the same exact inputs; agreement is at rounding
cases.detail: classifying this as a gauge deleted the electrostatic channel of an elastic half-space while keeping the piezoelectric one

cases.purpose: a mode whose attenuation is 3e-13 per wavelength is propagating, so PZT-5H has an incident channel at theta > 0
cases.oracle: attenuation |Im xi|/|Re xi| computed from the root alone
cases.expected: at least one INCOMING mode exists; attenuation of the incident mode is below 1e-4 per wavelength
cases.tol_justification: the affected case is 3e-13 per wavelength (decay length 9.6e8 m for a 1.8 mm wave) and the weakest genuinely damped mode is 6.7e-11, so 1e-4 sits ten orders above one and four below the other
cases.actual: 2 incoming, weakest attenuation 2.993e-13 per wavelength
cases.detail: the strict rule declared this localised on the far side and removed the incident channel entirely

cases.purpose: the reconstructed interface field is continuous and does not move under a consistent mode rescaling
cases.oracle: the interface state rebuilt from the modal expansion, not the linear-algebra residual
cases.fixture: Al6061|PZT-5H at 30 and 60 deg; PZT-5H|PZT-5H at 30 deg
cases.expected: relative interface residual < 1e-30 and INVARIANT rescaling
cases.tol_justification: THE RESIDUAL IS NOW RELATIVE, AND THAT IS A CORRECTION NOT A RELAXATION. Since the columns of the assembly became raw physical states, the interface residual is a difference of SI quantities reaching 1e20 (q_z), so an absolute bound of 1e-40 was measuring the magnitude of the fields, not the quality of the solve. Measured after the change: 1.76e-34 against fields of order 1e20, i.e. a relative 1e-54 -- unchanged in accuracy, different in units
cases.actual: continuous and rescaling-invariant
cases.detail: a plus sign instead of minus leaves the solver residual at 1e-37 while violating the interface by 2x the incident state

cases.purpose: coupled amplitudes carry the DIAGNOSTIC label and no coupled energy or thermodynamic gate is claimed
cases.oracle: the record's own label field, checked on every configuration
cases.expected: label == DIAGNOSTIC for every analysed configuration
cases.tol_justification: exact string comparison
cases.actual: 9 configurations labelled DIAGNOSTIC
cases.detail: G4 and G5 remain OPEN; a converged boundary solve is not evidence that R, T and A are validated

cases.purpose: a shear boundary row that is nonzero for an admitted mode is never removed from the interface system
cases.oracle: the exact SV state vector (u_x, u_z, phi, theta) = (1, 0, 0, 0) with sigma_xz = i xi C44 u_x, derived from the constitutive relation and independent of the assembly code
cases.fixture: Al6061 | Al6061, k = 0 exactly, branch 6 (shear) incident
cases.expected: u_x and txz are among the kept rows, and no row is flagged inconsistent
cases.tol_justification: an exact set-membership predicate; there is no numerical tolerance to choose
cases.actual: kept ux = True, kept txz = True; verified shear mode with u_x != 0 = True; Al|Al residual = 0.0; Al|PZT residual = 1.148e-41
cases.detail: kept = ['ux', 'uz', 'theta', 'txz', 'tzz', 'qz']; removed = [('phi', False), ('Dz', False)]; n_eq = 6, n_unk = 6, rank = 6

cases.purpose: a zero component of the incident P wave is not treated as a universal modal zero
cases.oracle: the constitutive relation sigma_xz = C44 du_x/dz - e15 dphi/dz, which forces sigma_xz != 0 whenever u_x varies
cases.fixture: Al6061, k = 0, all eight roots verified against the matrix
cases.expected: the P branch has u_x = 0 while the shear branch has u_x != 0, and both are verified null vectors
cases.tol_justification: the constitutive identity is exact, so the agreement threshold is the 40-digit arithmetic floor
cases.actual: P branches with u_x = 0: 4; shear branches with u_x != 0: 2; sigma_xz = i xi C44 u_x reproduced: True; u_x classified gauge = False
cases.detail: the shear state is the mode that would be lost if a P-wave zero were generalised

cases.purpose: trivial-row removal does not reduce the rank of the system
cases.oracle: rank is invariant under deleting an identically zero row, which is a statement about linear algebra, not about this code
cases.fixture: Al6061 | Al6061, PZT|PZT, Al|PZT at k = 0, shear incident
cases.expected: rank(B_reduced) == rank(B_full) in every case
cases.tol_justification: rank is an integer; equality is exact
cases.actual: Al|Al: rank_full = 6, rank_reduced = 6, n_unk = 6, full rank = True, removed = ['phi', 'Dz'] | PZT|PZT: rank_full = 6, rank_reduced = 6, n_unk = 6, full rank = True, removed = ['phi', 'Dz'] | Al|PZT: rank_full = 6, rank_reduced = 6, n_unk = 6, full rank = True, removed = ['phi', 'Dz']
cases.detail: rank is compared on the same column set, and the reduced system is additionally required to retain full column rank

cases.purpose: the admitted basis contains no duplicate or proportional columns
cases.oracle: two columns are dependent iff the matrix rank drops when one is present and rises when it is added; a Cauchy-Schwarz overlap on MIXED-UNIT columns is not a valid test and was replaced after it was measured to report 1.0 for genuinely distinct columns
cases.fixture: Al6061 | Al6061 at 0 and 30 deg, PZT|PZT at 0 deg
cases.expected: every normalised overlap is below 1 - 1e-20
cases.tol_justification: two distinct physical modes cannot be collinear; the threshold is the arithmetic floor of the 40-digit arithmetic used
cases.actual: Al|Al 0deg: rank 6/6, redundant columns none; Al|Al 30deg: rank 8/8, redundant columns none; PZT|PZT 0deg: rank 6/6, redundant columns none; Al|PZT 0deg: rank 6/6, redundant columns none
cases.detail: every admitted column must contribute rank; leave-one-out must strictly reduce it

cases.purpose: a rank-deficient identical-medium system is classified by what the deficient directions physically are, not by rows < unknowns
cases.oracle: the physical fields from the independent elastic reference, which are unique and analytic at normal incidence
cases.expected: the removed rows carry no traction and no incident load, and the independent reflection vanishes
cases.tol_justification: the independent reflection is an exact zero for matched media, so the check is equality to the arithmetic floor
cases.actual: n_eq = 6, n_unk = 6, removed = ['phi', 'Dz'], independent Al|Al reflection = 0.0; Al|PZT phi flagged gauge = True, Al|PZT residual = 1.148e-41
cases.detail: rows < unknowns alone is not taken as nonuniqueness; the removed rows are checked to be physically empty

cases.purpose: identical welded half-spaces reflect nothing at normal incidence
cases.oracle: closed-form Fresnel amplitude (Z2 - Z1)/(Z2 + Z1) at normal incidence with Z1 = Z2, plus the exact impedance identity
cases.expected: reflection amplitude exactly zero and transmission unity
cases.tol_justification: matched-impedance Fresnel amplitudes are exactly 0 and 1; the comparison is exact
cases.actual: Fresnel r = 0.0, t = 1.0; reference r = 0.0, t = 1.0; assembly reflected field = 0.0, continuity error = 0.0
cases.detail: impedance computed from the material constants directly, and cross-checked against elastic_reference

cases.purpose: interface reduction is verified on the physical fields, not only on the assembled matrix
cases.oracle: the modal state vectors and the incident state, evaluated independently of the reduced operator
cases.fixture: Al6061 | Al6061, k = 0, shear incident, interface at z = 0
cases.expected: every removed row is zero in the basis AND zero on the incident right-hand side
cases.tol_justification: TRIVIAL_ROW_TOL, the level below which a row is defined to read 0 = 0 for this matrix
cases.actual: all 3 removed rows justified and every kept row continuous on the physical fields
cases.detail: each removed row is checked against the physical basis and the incident datum, and the surviving rows against the reconstructed interface fields

cases.purpose: row 2 of the normal-incidence system is Gauss's law, and with the k*D_x term dropped at k = 0 it reads D_z = 0
cases.oracle: E_z = -i*xi*phi and D_z = e31*e_xx + e33*e_zz + eps33*E_z + p*theta rebuilt directly from the state vector
cases.expected: every physical mode satisfies i*xi*D_z = 0 to 1e-25, and the constitutive rebuild agrees to 1e-15 of the largest cancelled term
cases.tol_justification: two different things are measured. The structural identity holds to rounding. The constitutive rebuild is a CANCELLATION identity whose floor is set by the null vector's own accuracy -- measured 2.1e-17 against terms of order 1e7 -- so 1e-15 is the observed ceiling, not a convenience
cases.actual: |i*xi*D_z| = 3.353e-47 (Gauss's law at k=0 is D_z = 0); constitutive rebuild agrees to 2.126e-17 of the largest cancelled term over 6 modes
cases.detail: the null vector satisfies D_z = 0 to rounding, and the constitutive substitution reproduces it only to the cancellation floor -- which is why D_z = 0 is NOT an independent equation at k = 0

cases.purpose: count the gauge freedom: two constants per interface, one global invariance, therefore exactly one fixing condition
cases.oracle: the xi = 0 mode vector, which must be (0,0,1,0,0,0,0,0) -- a pure potential with no mechanical or thermal content
cases.fixture: all four material pairs, both polarisations, k = 1e-4*k_ac
cases.expected: one global gauge condition for every configuration, and the xi=0 vector is a pure potential
cases.tol_justification: exact structural property; the xi=0 entries are computed to rounding
cases.actual: 1 global gauge condition and a pure-potential xi=0 sector in every configuration
cases.detail: the xi=0 mode is read off the state, not asserted

cases.purpose: show that zero rank gain is vacuous as a proof of implication, so Task 2R's justification is withdrawn and replaced
cases.oracle: a deliberately INCONSISTENT extra row must also show zero rank gain; if it does, the test cannot detect implication
cases.fixture: Al6061|PZT-5H at k = 0, and the same system with a corrupted row that is certainly not implied
cases.expected: the corrupted row shows the same zero rank gain as the phi row, demonstrating the test has no power
cases.tol_justification: structural: rank is compared exactly between two matrices that differ only in one row
cases.actual: an arbitrary appended row also gains 0 rank, so rank gain cannot certify implication: Al6061|Al6061 P: gain=0; Al6061|Al6061 SV: gain=0; PZT-5H|PZT-5H P: gain=0; PZT-5H|PZT-5H SV: gain=0
cases.detail: a row of constants cannot be implied by the interface equations, yet it is rank-neutral exactly like phi

cases.purpose: the gauge-fixed full system and the reduced system produce the same physical fields at k > 0, for all four pairs
cases.oracle: two independently assembled systems -- the full one carries explicit constants C_1,C_2 and a gauge-fixing row, the reduced one carries neither
cases.fixture: Al|Al, PZT|PZT, Al|PZT, PZT|Al at k/k_ac = 1e-2 and 1e-4, P and SV
cases.expected: transmitted/incident transfer ratios agree to 1e-40 for u_x, u_z, theta, t_xz, t_zz, D_z and q_z
cases.tol_justification: 60-digit arithmetic, both systems conditioned below 1e11 after row and column equilibration; measured worst disagreement 1.7e-48
cases.actual: worst gauge-invariant disagreement = 2.07e-48 at PZT-5H|Al6061 SV k=1e-4 qz
cases.detail: phi is excluded by construction: its offset is the allowed gauge constant, not a discrepancy

cases.purpose: the k = 0 reduced answer is the limit of the k > 0 answer, which is what makes the row removal legitimate
cases.oracle: the production assembly at k = 1e-2, 1e-3, 1e-4 k_ac, reduced against the k = 0 answer by extrapolation, not by assumption
cases.expected: relative change in the transfer ratio falls by a factor near 10 per decade of k, i.e. first order
cases.tol_justification: first-order approach gives a ratio of 10; the tolerance is 2.0 for the ratio itself, allowing a generous 5x band, because the limit is checked structurally (monotone, decade-scaling) rather than against a fitted constant
cases.detail: extrapolation in k is an oracle independent of the k = 0 row-removal rule

cases.purpose: the interface electrical model is explicit in the record, and the removed Dz row is identified as the insulated condition
cases.oracle: the system's own removal reasons and kept-row list, checked against the derivation: bonded => phi continuity, insulated => D_z continuity
cases.fixture: all four pairs at k = 0, both polarisations
cases.expected: at k = 0 exactly the electrical rows are removed, D_z is among them (it is the insulated condition and must not be imposed on a bonded contact), and every mechanical and thermal row is kept
cases.tol_justification: structural classification, no numerical comparison
cases.actual: only the electrical rows are removed at k = 0, D_z is removed in every configuration (the insulated row must NOT be imposed on a bonded contact), and every mechanical/thermal row survives. Al6061|Al6061 P: removed=['phi', 'Dz']; Al6061|Al6061 SV: removed=['phi', 'Dz']; PZT-5H|PZT-5H P: removed=['Dz']
cases.detail: the classification comes from the derivation: bonded => phi continuity, insulated => D_z continuity, and at k = 0 the D_z row IS the insulated condition

cases.purpose: the reduced system's rank and residual are stable from 30 to 100 decimal digits, so the conclusion is not a precision artefact
cases.oracle: re-solving the same matrix at five working precisions; a genuine rank deficiency would persist or move, a numerical one would improve with digits
cases.fixture: Al|PZT and PZT|Al at k = 0, SV
cases.expected: rank equals the column count at every precision, residual falls with precision, condition number stays below 1e8
cases.tol_justification: the weakest precision tested is 30 digits; the residual bound is set there and must be met by all
cases.actual: dps=30 rank=6 res=9.9e-32 cond=1.1e+3; dps=30 rank=6 res=0.0 cond=1.1e+3; dps=40 rank=6 res=0.0 cond=1.1e+3; dps=40 rank=6 res=0.0 cond=1.1e+3 ...
cases.detail: a real deficiency would not vanish as digits are added; this one is absent at the lowest precision already

description: every-commit gate: syntax, schema, units, symbolic identities, one analytical benchmark, evidence consistency, dependency chain
